info.description: Event-driven Go API backed by MongoDB and Redis. Every request carries a correlation ID (X-Correlation-ID), generated by the server if the caller doesn't supply one.
info.title: Metarr API

post.description: Compares the submitted username/password against the stored admin credentials and issues a session API key carrying admin rights.
post.summary: Log in as the admin user

post.description: Revokes the session API key that authenticated this request.

get.description: Reads the singleton application config document from MongoDB.

put.description: Fires a system_config_update event with the updated document as its payload and returns as soon as the event has been queued. The SystemConfigUpdate listener persists the change to MongoDB and then refreshes the in-memory config singleton.
Updates any subset of the admin user's username, email, and password. A provided field cannot be empty. If password is set, it is re-hashed with a fresh salt.

400.description: invalid request body, or a provided field was empty

get.description: Reads the application config from MongoDB and returns the directory scanner section (parallel_count and scan_directories).

put.description: Updates parallel_count. A provided value must be greater than zero.

400.description: invalid request body, or parallel_count was not greater than zero

get.description: Reads the application config from MongoDB and returns every configured scan directory.

post.description: Adds a new scan directory. scanner_slug is required and must be unique, and scan_type must be one of "movie", "tv" or "music_video".

400.description: invalid request body, missing scanner_slug, or unknown scan_type

get.description: Reads the application config from MongoDB and returns the scan directory instance with the given scanner_slug.

404.description: no scan directory with that slug

put.description: Replaces every field of the scan directory at the given scanner_slug except scanner_slug itself, which cannot be changed once set. scan_type must be one of "movie", "tv" or "music_video".

400.description: invalid request body, attempted to change scanner_slug, or unknown scan_type

404.description: no scan directory with that slug

delete.description: Removes the scan directory with the given scanner_slug and fires system_config_update with the resulting document.

404.description: no scan directory with that slug

get.description: Reads the application config from MongoDB and returns every configured Sonarr instance.

post.description: Adds a new Sonarr instance. instance_slug is required and must be unique across every interface type.

400.description: invalid request body or missing instance_slug

get.description: Reads the application config from MongoDB and returns the Sonarr instance with the given instance_slug.
get.summary: Fetch a single Sonarr interface instance

404.description: no Sonarr instance with that slug

put.description: Replaces every field of the Sonarr instance at the given instance_slug except instance_slug itself, which cannot be changed once set.

400.description: invalid request body, or attempted to change instance_slug

404.description: no Sonarr instance with that slug

delete.description: Removes the Sonarr instance with the given instance_slug and fires system_config_update with the resulting document.

404.description: no Sonarr instance with that slug

get.description: Publishes a heartbeat request on the Redis Pub/Sub queue and blocks until the heartbeat listener replies with the current time and the request's correlation ID.
Returns the directory records in the local_directory collection, optionally filtered by media type and scan root path.

parameters.description: Filter by media type: movie, tv or music_video
parameters.name: type

parameters.description: Filter by the configured scan directory these were found under
parameters.name: scan_root

get.description: Returns one directory record by its generated id.
Returns the media file records — the movie, episode or music video files themselves — belonging to one scanned directory.
Reads and parses one .nfo file inside a scanned directory, live from disk rather than from the scan snapshot. The path is relative to the directory and may not escape it.
get.summary: Read an NFO file from disk

parameters.description: Path to the .nfo file, relative to the directory
parameters.name: path

400.description: missing or unsafe path, or not an .nfo file

404.description: no directory with that id, or no such file

422.description: the file could not be parsed

get.description: Returns one media file record by its generated id, including its own NFO metadata, subtitles, artwork and episode ids.

404.description: no media file with that id

post.description: Scans the configured scan directory with the given scanner_slug, storing one record per media item directory plus one per media file in the local_directory collection. Fires the directory_scan event onto the durable event stream and returns as soon as it has been queued.

parameters.description: scanner_slug of the scan directory to scan
parameters.name: slug

400.description: invalid request body, unsupported command, or the entry has an unusable scan_type

404.description: no scan directory with that slug

post.description: Fires the sonarr_cache_data event onto the durable event stream in a non-blocking way and returns as soon as the event has been queued.

400.description: invalid request body or unsupported command

index.description: Index distinguishes numbered artwork such as backdrop-1 and backdrop2.

files.description:
Files holds everything in the tree that is not a media file: artwork,
directory-level NFO sidecars, theme music, trailers and other extras,
disc structure, and anything unrecognized.

episode_ids.description:
EpisodeIDs holds this episode's own external provider identifiers, kept
separate from the directory's series-level external_links.

parse_error.description:
ParseError records why an NFO could not be read. A malformed sidecar is
reported here rather than failing the scan.

extra_type.description: ExtraType and ExtraSource are set only on extra videos.

season_number.description:
SeasonNumber is nil when it could not be resolved, which is different
from season zero (specials).

ApiKeyHeaderAuth.description: API key via the X-Api-Key header.
ApiKeyHeaderAuth.name: X-Api-Key

ApiKeyQueryAuth.description: API key via the apikey query parameter. Either this or ApiKeyHeaderAuth satisfies auth on protected routes.
ApiKeyQueryAuth.name: apikey
